typeDesc.partner: Sees what you choose and, if you allow it, logs things for you.
typeDesc.spouse: Like a partner, plus your children are shared and you become one family.

family.title: Your family
family.pending: Once {name} accepts, your family is created.
family.childrenSoon: Shared children appear here once the children section is available.

list.title: Companions
list.heading: The people beside you
list.lead: Each companion only sees what you have allowed.
list.emptyBody: Invite your spouse or partner. They only see what you allow, and you can remove them any time.
list.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
list.expired: Invite expired · make a new code

access.question: What should they have access to?
access.lead: Pick one for each item. Change it whenever you like.
access.note: With «view & edit» for medications or appointments, your companion can choose to log for themselves or for you.

children.question: Which child is shared?
children.lead: The child you pick is added to both of your panels and you become one family.
children.soonBody: Once you add your children in Ritme, you can pick the shared ones here. For now, continue without it.
children.partnerNote: If your companion is a partner, this step is skipped.

invite.title: Invite a companion
invite.heading: Invite them
invite.lead: Send an invite to their mobile number or give them the companion code. They see nothing until they accept.
invite.name: Their name
invite.namePlaceholder: The name you'll see in Ritme
invite.phoneInvalid: The mobile number must start with 09 and have 11 digits.
invite.codeLead: Give this code to your companion to enter when signing up to Ritme.
invite.codeHidden: The code appears here once the invite is created.
invite.smsNotSent: The SMS wasn't sent — send them the code yourself.
invite.codeOnly: Code created — send it to your companion.
invite.error: Couldn't create the invite. Try again.

done.leadSpouse: Once they accept, your family is created.
done.leadPartner: Once they accept, they only see what you allowed.
done.note: Change access or remove the companion any time from the companions page.

code.label: Invite code {code}
code.failed: Couldn't copy — write the code down from the screen.
code.once: This code is shown only now.

detail.title: Companion
detail.notFoundBody: They may have been removed already.
detail.accessLead: Changes apply the next time your companion opens the app.
detail.renewNote: A new code stops the previous one from working.
detail.renewError: Couldn't make a new code. Try again.
detail.removeBody: Their access ends right now and they won't see anything of yours. To add them back you'll need to invite them again.

privacy.pending: {count, plural, one {# invite waiting} other {# invites waiting}}
